lines.text: Gradient descent optimization demo — a ball rolling downhill on a loss surface
A held marble-in-a-bowl rolling down to its minimum
falling is how it learns. Gradient descent never sees the landscape
lines.note: the marble solves a minimization it did not pose: the bowl is authored — seed 46, one deep well, two shallow dips — so descent supplies the rule and never the surface, and the placer it dissolves only moves up a level.

lines.text: Minimal surface formed by rotating a catenary curve
lines.note: the chain solves for its curve but not for its anchors, and this one does not solve at all — a cubic spline sagged by a hand-set 0.5, so the map's proof that shape is computed rather than drawn is itself drawn.

lines.text: Ruled minimal surface — a plane rotating as it rises
A grid of masses and springs settling on a bench - each spring pulling to rest length
lines.note: nobody modelled the slump but somebody wired the net — 4 by 3 by 4, cell 0.16 — and somebody set 80 pre-steps, deciding when settled counts as settled, so the fossil records the forces and the clock equally.

lines.text: A cloth relaxing under a Verlet integrator with a constraint-pass dial - integrate position from position
Duration is DNA. The clock is part of the genome
A room-scale branching truss whose struts split into thinner struts - the Eiffel trick
lines.note: strength from geometry needs somewhere to stop recursing and the principle does not say where: depth is 3, clamped to 4 from outside, and below the last split the strut is solid again and the material comes back.

lines.text: a point is position; a line is relation; a triangle is the relation made rigid
A room with a deep narrow DEAD well (rigid, one shape) and a shallow wide ALIVE well (soft
lines.note: energy has no opinion about which minimum is alive, so the room supplies the verdict the landscape cannot — dead well grey at x −2, alive well green at x +2 — then reads it back off the floor as physics.

lines.text: A soft body settling on a wavy energy-landscape surface where height is energy

pearls.edge: the chamber's verb is to settle, and nothing in it settles: the forces stone fires an amber mortar that adds damping for three seconds inside two metres. a hung point needs a solver the bracelet does not have.

lines.text: A forge where raw matter descends toward max Q
lines.note: found not imposed, except the form is imposed — _build_form_targets writes the answer before the run and Q is a sine rather than a measurement, so the forge stages the descent whose whole claim is that it cannot be staged.

lines.text: A soft body descending an energy landscape toward max Q with a step/energy readout - the same motion as training a model
